specs.name: Washout then K-over-D turn
specs.mechanism_en: Weekly washout first, THEN the StochRSI K-over-D upcross from oversold within 15 sessions: the operator's basing ladder ordered causally instead of simultaneously.

specs.name: V-bottom acceleration flip
specs.mechanism_en: Sharp weekly downdraft (vel_1w < -1.5%/wk) followed within 10 sessions by the acceleration z-score crossing above zero: the V-bottom shape.

specs.name: Capitulation then persistence resumes
specs.mechanism_en: A one-day capitulation print (ret < -3%) followed within 10 sessions by RS persistence recovering above 0.55: forced selling absorbed, trend participation resuming.

specs.name: Weekly oversold then daily velocity flip
specs.mechanism_en: Weekly StochRSI K below 20 first, THEN the daily velocity spread (vel_1w - vel_3m) crossing positive within 8 sessions: the multi-timeframe confluence engine the operator trades.

specs.name: Credit relief then washout turn
specs.mechanism_en: High-yield spread widening stops FIRST (hy_oas_chg_10d crosses below 0), THEN a washout K-over-D turn within 10 sessions: macro pressure release ordered before the technical turn.

specs.name: Rate relief then sector washout
specs.mechanism_en: Rates rally first (tlt_ret_10d crosses above 0), THEN a sector weekly washout within 10 sessions: buys rate-sensitive capitulations after the rate headwind relents.

specs.name: Dip inside rotation then re-ignition
specs.mechanism_en: A down day inside an active same-node IN rotation, THEN acceleration flips positive within 8 sessions: buys the first pullback's resolution, not the pullback itself.

specs.name: Oversold pullback inside active rotation
specs.mechanism_en: Weekly StochRSI K crossing below 40 while the node's own IN rotation is active: a pullback trigger inside an armed condition (condition and trigger separated).

specs.name: Down day inside confirmed rotation
specs.mechanism_en: A -1.5% down day while the node's IN rotation is at confirmed tier: dip-buying inside confirmed episodes — the family the OTA assessment flagged as unmeasured, now measured at the reversion ruler.

specs.name: Displacement destination leader
specs.mechanism_en: At least two opposite-complex nodes in outflow onset while THIS node already leads (rs>0) and is not overbought (K<60): buys the destination of displaced money rather than the washed-out source.

specs.name: Displacement then acceleration
specs.mechanism_en: Opposite-complex outflow onset FIRST, then this node's acceleration crossing above +0.5 within 10 sessions: routed-inflow proxy ordered causally.
